complexity.notes: Uses integer division (prod // num) in the no-zero case, directly violating the problem's explicit 'no division' requirement. Slices nums[:zero] and nums[zero+1:] create O(n) extra copies, so space is O(n) rather than the O(1) achievable with a prefix/suffix product pass. Correctness itself is fine given the stated 32-bit fit guarantee.
complexity.summary: Zero-counting approach: if more than one zero, all outputs are 0; if exactly one zero, the product of all nonzero elements is placed at the zero's index; otherwise it computes the total product and divides by each element.
